issues.description: The problem statement specifies the build_msd_circ parameter y_states as a tuple[int], while the template and the solution both declare y_states as list[int]. This is a parameter type/annotation mismatch between the specification and the provided starter/solution code. Although Python will accept either at runtime, the mismatch can confuse students about the expected container type for y_states (tuple vs list) and may cause minor friction when following type-hinted examples or tests that expect a particular sequence type.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the type annotation consistent across artifacts. Either change the problem statement to use list[int] for y_states, or update the template and solution signatures to accept tuple[int]. A more robust option is to specify a generic sequence type (e.g., collections.abc.Sequence[int] or typing.Iterable[int]) in the problem statement and templates so both lists and tuples are clearly acceptable.
